title: Sparkly windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='8' fill='#3a7d3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='42' ry='6' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <!-- grass tufts -->
  <path d='M12 86 Q16 80 20 86' fill='#66bb6a' stroke='#66bb6a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M78 86 Q82 80 86 86' fill='#66bb6a' stroke='#66bb6a' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <polygon points='42,55 58,55 63,86 37,86' fill='#e8c87a'/>
  <polygon points='42,55 58,55 63,86 50,86' fill='#d4a94e'/>
  <!-- tower shading -->
  <polygon points='42,55 50,55 50,86 37,86' fill='#f0d68a'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='74' width='8' height='12' rx='2' fill='#8b5e2a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='80' r='1' fill='#f0d68a'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='4' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='60' x2='50' y2='68' stroke='#5ba3c2' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='64' x2='54' y2='64' stroke='#5ba3c2' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- mill top / cap -->
  <polygon points='38,55 62,55 55,42 45,42' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <polygon points='45,42 55,42 50,34' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3' fill='#f1c40f'/>

  <!-- windmill blades - 4 sails -->
  <!-- blade 1 (up) -->
  <g transform='rotate(0 50 44)'>
    <rect x='48' y='10' width='4' height='30' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='20' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='28' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='52' y='10' width='2' height='30' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- blade 2 (right) -->
  <g transform='rotate(90 50 44)'>
    <rect x='48' y='10' width='4' height='30' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='20' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='28' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='52' y='10' width='2' height='30' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- blade 3 (down) -->
  <g transform='rotate(180 50 44)'>
    <rect x='48' y='10' width='4' height='30' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='20' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='28' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='52' y='10' width='2' height='30' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- blade 4 (left) -->
  <g transform='rotate(270 50 44)'>
    <rect x='48' y='10' width='4' height='30' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='20' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='44' y='28' width='12' height='4' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
    <rect x='52' y='10' width='2' height='30' fill='#c0c0c0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- centre hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='5' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3' fill='#f39c12'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- sparkle top-left -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <polygon points='14,18 16,24 22,22 17,26 19,32 14,28 9,32 11,26 6,22 12,24'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle top-right -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <polygon points='82,14 84,19 89,17 85,21 87,26 82,23 77,26 79,21 75,17 80,19'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle bottom-left -->
  <g fill='#ffd700'>
    <polygon points='18,68 20,72 24,71 21,74 22,78 18,76 14,78 15,74 12,71 16,72'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle bottom-right -->
  <g fill='#ffd700'>
    <polygon points='84,70 86,74 90,73 87,76 88,80 84,78 80,80 81,76 78,73 82,74'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small sparkle top centre -->
  <g fill='#fff59d'>
    <polygon points='28,8 29,11 32,10 30,13 31,16 28,14 25,16 26,13 24,10 27,11'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small sparkle right -->
  <g fill='#fff59d'>
    <polygon points='90,45 91,48 94,47 92,50 93,53 90,51 87,53 88,50 86,47 89,48'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny sparkle left -->
  <g fill='#fff59d'>
    <polygon points='8,48 9,51 12,50 10,53 11,56 8,54 5,56 6,53 4,50 7,51'/>
  </g>
  <!-- extra tiny diamonds -->
  <rect x='34' y='18' width='3' height='3' fill='#fff176' transform='rotate(45 35.5 19.5)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='22' width='3' height='3' fill='#fff176' transform='rotate(45 67.5 23.5)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='2' height='2' fill='#fff176' transform='rotate(45 25 53)'/>
  <rect x='74' y='56' width='2' height='2' fill='#fff176' transform='rotate(45 75 57)'/>

  <!-- sun peeking in corner -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='10' r='7' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='10' r='5' fill='#ffc107'/>
</svg>
